ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic and visionary tone, emphasizing future growth and innovation.

ToneOptions.Label: Pragmatic & Confident
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a pragmatic and confident tone, focusing on achievable outcomes and controlled evolution.

ToneOptions.Label: Risk-Aware & Balanced
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a risk-aware yet balanced tone, highlighting mitigation and robust planning.

ToneOptions.Label: Transformative & Enabling
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Use a transformative and enabling tone, showcasing new capabilities and business advantages.

GoalOptions.Label: Secure Multi-Cloud Approval
GoalOptions.Text: Obtain executive and board approval to initiate the strategic expansion to a multi-cloud model. This includes securing the necessary budget and resources to onboard an alternate hyperscaler for specialized AI/ML and data workloads, while ensuring seamless integration with existing Azure governance and platform engineering practices.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Tech Vision
GoalOptions.Text: Align the Board and VP Engineering with the CTO's vision for a future-ready cloud architecture. This goal aims to establish a shared understanding of how multi-cloud adoption will directly address evolving AI/ML and data-intensive workload demands, enhance scalability, and mitigate vendor concentration risk, positioning the organization for sustained innovation.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Strategic Necessity
GoalOptions.Text: Validate the strategic necessity of multi-cloud adoption for advanced AI/ML and data workloads. The document should clearly articulate why the current single-hyperscaler foundation is insufficient for future demands and how a targeted multi-cloud approach provides access to differentiated services and capabilities crucial for competitive advantage.

GoalOptions.Label: Showcase Controlled Evolution
GoalOptions.Text: Showcase a controlled and integrated evolution path for cloud infrastructure. The objective is to demonstrate that expanding to a multi-cloud model can be achieved without compromising existing Azure governance, operational efficiency, or security posture, ensuring a smooth transition and minimal disruption to current operations.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Strategic Impact
Criteria: Board approval for multi-cloud initiative and initial budget allocation.
Clear articulation of ROI for specialized AI/ML capabilities and risk mitigation.
Demonstrated alignment with long-term business growth and innovation objectives.
Identification of key business units benefiting from enhanced cloud capabilities.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Operational Readiness
Criteria: Feasibility of integrating new hyperscaler with existing Azure governance and platform engineering.
Defined roadmap for skill development and operational model adaptation.
Assessment of initial workload candidates for multi-cloud deployment.
Identification of key architectural principles for multi-cloud interoperability.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Risk & Compliance Mitigation
Criteria: Comprehensive analysis of vendor concentration risk reduction.
Outline of security and compliance framework extension to the new hyperscaler.
Strategy for data residency and sovereignty across multi-cloud environments.
Plan for maintaining operational efficiency and cost control in a multi-cloud setup.
